Export Info
Route Date changes imported routes only. Orders keep their imported Earliest/Latest Time Window dates. Region Code exports to the Output File worksheet in column B: Region Code.
Order Cut Filter (Orders Only)
Select the new cut(s) being added. The full file is still used to remove missing orders and refresh ORDER_STATUS values for orders already in the session.
Route Cost Analysis
Used for projected net revenue. Dollar signs, decimals, cents symbols, and the word “cents” are accepted.
Backhaul Import Filters
These filters only apply to Backhauls mode. Blank values import/display all matching rows.
Vendor Import / 3PL Lanes Filter
Uses column G “Division” on the 3PL Lanes tab. Choose “Display all vendors” or enter one or more Division values, such as 9B, to import only those vendor/lane rows.
Depots / Depot Locations
Depots use column B “Branch (Division)”, column C “Location Type”, or column K “Market” from Depot Locations. The vendor and depot filters are separate, so you can import Division 9B vendors and either all locations, DEPOT only, DC only, or matching Branch/Market locations.
Route Day Filter (uses Route Templates UDFString2)
No day selected = import all route days.
Route Start Date Filter (Import Route Data — uses RouteStart)
Load a Route Detail file to see available RouteStart dates.
Select one or multiple RouteStart dates. Leave all dates unchecked to import every date in the file.
Depot Filter (Import Route Data — starting depot)
Load a Route Detail file to see available starting depots.
Select one or multiple starting depots. Leave all depots unchecked to import routes from every depot in the selected date range.

Tandem Order Status Glossary

Optimization Options

Choose the constraints to respect while optimizing.

Scenario Levers

Run Model starts from the original imported Route Detail baseline, applies the selected levers, and can optimize/rebalance the network. Run Lite ReOp also starts from the original baseline, but only applies the requested direct changes and recalculates their effect on the existing routes — it does not reroute, resequence, condense routes, move surviving stops between routes, or enforce runtime balancing. If removals leave a route with no customer stops, that route remains in the scenario as an Empty Route. Removed orders remain visible as unassigned work. Full Model also treats matched truck Cube and Weight as hard capacity limits and deliberately tests whether light normal routes can be fully retired after scenario removals; Lite ReOp does not reroute or consolidate work. Partial Order Type scenarios use the same percentage/distance selection in both Lite ReOp and Full Model.

Optimization Mode

Improve Existing Routes uses the imported solution as the incumbent and keeps only beneficial changes. Build From Scratch clears customer assignments inside the model and rebuilds the remaining freight across the available imported route resources. All Scenario Levers apply in either mode. Build From Scratch defaults Route Lock and Sequence Lock to removed so the model can truly rebuild the network; you can intentionally turn either restriction back on afterward. If Route Run Time fields are blank, VectorOps uses each resource's imported availability/run-time setting instead of applying one network-wide limit.

Order Types — Ignore

Choose whether the percentage applies to matching order lines, matching customer stops, or matching case volume. When the percentage is below 100%, VectorOps prioritizes customers beyond the Distance Allowance first, starting with the farthest customer and working back toward the depot. Blank Distance Allowance still ranks farthest to nearest.

Minimum Case Count

Orders are combined by LocationKey and planned delivery day. If the remaining combined cases are below the entered minimum, those orders are moved to Unassigned.

Customer Windows

Open moves the EarlyDateTime earlier by the entered minutes. Close moves the LateDateTime later. Ignore All Customer Windows overrides those imported windows with 07:00–20:00.

Routing Locks

Assigned Customer Depot

Yes keeps each customer tied to the depot that serviced it in the original imported solution. If the optimizer moves the customer, it may only use another route assigned to that same depot. No allows the optimizer to use the most efficient feasible route across depots.

Optimization

Full Model treats this as an absolute service target, not an improvement-versus-import target. Default is 95%.
Default 5 minutes. This is the maximum planned wait allowed at any individual customer stop during Full Model optimization. VectorOps still penalizes every minute of wait and prefers zero wait whenever a feasible alternative exists; this allowance is not added to every stop.

Route Run Time

Hard limits for normal active modeled routes. Layover routes (route name contains Layover or a LocationKey beginning with L) are exempt from these network-wide Min/Max values and instead use layover-day limits: up to 10 active hours before each hotel anchor and up to 8 active hours after the final hotel anchor. An unused route with no planned stops is allowed.

Optional Delivery Expense Assumptions

If supplied, the After Action Report also estimates delivery expense as miles × cost/mile + route hours × cost/hour. Blank fields do not create a dollar estimate.

Scenario Removal Details

Assign Route to Driver

Publish this route directly to Driver Mode through the shared VectorOps database. The JSON download remains available as a backup/manual handoff option.

BHL Depot Distance Analysis

BHL Build Routes

Creates dummy BHL routes by Division/Branch. Each vendor gets a 2 hour service time. Vendors are first grouped into 30-mile geographic clusters, then each cluster is packed into the fewest feasible routes. Routes use the matching DC as the start and end depot and prioritize clean distance-based loops unless Ideal Routes is entered.

Delivery Safety Assessment

Uses imported customer coordinates, Esri aerial imagery, Mapillary street imagery when available, and Workers AI vision to strengthen the existing remote safety screen. This remains a pre-site-review assessment and should be field verified before final approval.
Assessment is based on imported customers only; no routing logic is changed.

Safety Detail

Schedule Me — Projected Delivery Window

Non-destructive simulation: Schedule Me evaluates the prospective customer against the currently imported routes. It does not add the customer, resequence a route, or modify Scenario Levers. Recommended windows are based on where the imported route network naturally reaches the area and the downstream impact of inserting the stop. If the requested date does not exactly match the source route date, VectorOps uses the imported routed network as the reference delivery pattern.
